designSummary: Time-ordered weekly measurement on a run chart, with a p-chart as a secondary display: 8 baseline points, then 12 points during three PDSA cycles.
sampleSize: Twenty handoff sheets per week is what the medication safety nurse can review in about an hour. With a baseline near 38 percent, a p-chart with subgroups of 20 has 3-sigma limits about 33 percentage points either side of the centre line, so it would flag only very large single-week changes; the run chart rules are more sensitive to sustained change. A fall to about 20 percent held for six consecutive weeks meets the shift rule (6 or more consecutive points below the baseline median), and that is the smallest change the team considers worth keeping. Eight baseline points give a usable median; 12 intervention points allow the shift rule to trigger during cycle 2 or 3.
primaryAnalysis: Run chart of the weekly proportion with the baseline median as centre line, judged by pre-specified rules: a shift (6 or more consecutive points on one side of the median), a trend (5 or more consecutive increases or decreases), too many or too few runs, and an astronomical point agreed by the team. The median is frozen after baseline and recalculated only after a sustained shift.
secondaryAnalysis: p-chart of the same data with 3-sigma limits for context; run charts of checklist completion, patient participation, handoff duration and patients reporting being woken. Missed items are described separately for patients who could not take part in the bedside check.
missingData: Weeks with fewer than 20 reviewable sheets are plotted with their actual subgroup size and annotated; missing sheets are counted and reported, never imputed.
multiplicity: One outcome measure carries the aim; process and balancing measures are descriptive and are not tested for significance.
software: Spreadsheet run chart template kept by the medication safety nurse; charts checked by the ward pharmacist.
overfittingGuards: Run chart rules fixed before baseline
Baseline median frozen until a sustained shift
No subgroup testing beyond the pre-specified participation split
Changes between cycles are marked on the chart before the next points are examined
summary: Run chart with pre-specified rules; 20 sheets per week; sample size set by review capacity and the smallest change worth keeping.
